title: 第六章 千骑压堡，血阻狂潮
slug: 穿越戍边我从炮灰辅卒一路封王
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

弯刀出鞘的颤鸣撕裂风雪，清亮刺耳，压过了漫天呼啸的寒风。

黑羯王穆耶高高举着战刀，凛冽目光死死锁着下方残破的黑石堡。他整整一千羯族精骑整齐列阵，黑色甲胄连成一片，如同蛰伏雪原的铁兽，杀气死死笼罩整座孤堡。

能被穆耶带在身边亲征的，全是黑羯本部百战精锐，每一人的搏杀本领，都远超之前翻墙袭扰的普通羯兵。

千骑结阵冲锋，冲击力足以撞碎数倍的步军人墙，踏平这座墙残瓦碎的小小戍堡，根本不费余力。

周疤子刚搬完一堆干柴跑回墙头，望着下方整齐肃杀的羯骑阵列，脸色难看至极：“是羯王亲卫骑队，北疆出了名的死战部队，从不留俘，从不退阵。”

“对上这支部队，我们九死一生。”

士卒们刚刚燃起的一点士气，瞬间又沉了下去。

人数差距悬殊，对方全员骑兵、披甲带刃、久经沙场，己方全员带伤、兵刃残缺、无甲无援，胜算渺茫。

唯独苏烬眼神没变，依旧沉稳冷厉。

对方不会直接铺天盖地合围碾压，给了他们拖延时间、示警援军的机会。

只要浓烟能撑到援军察觉异常，只要能扛住这第一轮雷霆冲锋，他们就有活路。

“动作再快！柴火全部堆稳，浇上堡里残存的菜油！”苏烬转头冲着后院大喝一声。

周疤子立刻应声，带着人把仅存的几坛劣质菜油尽数泼在干柴堆上。

风雪太大，普通柴火燃烧容易被压灭，混上油脂，浓烟才够浓密、够持久，才能穿透层层风雪，送到数里之外援军的视野中。

下方雪原上，穆耶冷眼瞧着堡内众人的举动，嘴角冷笑更甚。

他看懂了这群残兵的意图。

燃烟示警，想要拦下游走送死的大雍援军。

区区二十余残卒，绝境之中还敢反扑搅局，倒是让他有些意外。

“有点胆量。”

穆耶低声吐出几字，握刀的手臂缓缓下沉，声线冰冷，传遍全军。

“先锋百骑，冲锋！踏平墙垛，斩杀所有守军！”

令落，动如雷霆。

一百名黑羯精骑同时夹紧马腹，战马扬蹄狂奔，铁蹄踏碎厚厚的积雪，带出轰鸣巨响。

马蹄声汇聚一处，越来越近，地面微微震颤，黑色骑队如同离弦利箭，直直冲向黑石堡正面墙体。

马上羯兵俯身压低重心，一手控马，一手紧握弯刀，眼神凶悍嗜血，冲锋途中已经做好登墙劈杀的准备。

墙头之上，所有人瞬间绷紧神经，手心沁满冷汗。

“列阵！守住正面！”苏烬沉声大喝。

陈石头带着几名士卒，把收集好的碎石、断矛尽数摆在墙垛旁，众人两两一组，死死贴紧墙体，屏住呼吸盯着冲来的骑队。

content_en:
Page (1/3)

The trembling sound of the scimitar tearing through the wind and snow, clear and harsh, overcame the howling cold wind in the sky.

The Black Capricorn King Muye held his sword high, his stern eyes fixed on the broken Black Stone Castle below.A thousand of his Jie tribe's elite cavalry were arrayed neatly, their black armors connected together, like iron beasts dormant in the snowy fields, and their murderous aura enveloped the entire lonely castle.

Those who can be brought by Mu Ye to fight in person are all the elites of the Black Jie headquarters, and the fighting skills of each of them are far superior to the ordinary Jie soldiers who climbed over the wall to harass them before.

Thousands of cavalry charged in formation, the impact force was enough to smash several times the infantry wall, and flatten this small fort with broken walls without any effort at all.

Zhou Scarzi had just finished moving a pile of dry firewood and ran back to the wall. He looked at the orderly and solemn array of Jie cavalry below, with an extremely ugly expression on his face: "This is King Jie's personal guard cavalry. They are famous for fighting to the death in northern Xinjiang. They never leave prisoners behind and never retreat from the formation."

"Facing this force, we have a narrow escape."

The morale that the soldiers had just ignited suddenly sank again.

There is a huge disparity in numbers. The opponent's cavalry is all equipped with armor and blades, and they have been battle-hardened for a long time. All of our own are wounded, their weapons are incomplete, and they have no armor and no support. The chance of winning is slim.

Only Su Jin's eyes did not change, still calm and cold.

The other side would not directly encircle and crush them, giving them the opportunity to delay and warn reinforcements.

As long as the thick smoke can hold up until the reinforcements notice something is wrong, and as long as they can withstand the first round of thunderous charges, they will have a way to survive.

"Move quickly! Pile all the firewood and pour the remaining vegetable oil in the fort!" Su Jin turned to the backyard and shouted.

Zhou Scarzi immediately responded and led his men to pour all the remaining jars of low-quality vegetable oil on the pile of dry firewood.

The wind and snow were so strong that ordinary firewood would be easily extinguished by burning it. Mixed with grease, the smoke would be thick enough and long-lasting enough to penetrate the layers of wind and snow and reach the sight of the reinforcements several miles away.

On the snowy field below, Mu Ye looked at the actions of everyone in the castle with cold eyes, and the sneer on his lips became even worse.

He understood the intentions of these remnant soldiers.

Burning smoke as a warning, they wanted to stop Dayong's reinforcements from wandering to their death.

He was a little surprised that there were only about 20 remnant soldiers who dared to counterattack and disrupt the situation in a desperate situation.

"Some guts."

Muye murmured a few words in a low voice, the arm holding the knife slowly lowered, and his cold voice spread throughout the entire army.

"The vanguard of hundreds of cavalry, charge! Flatten the wall and kill all the defenders!"

When the order falls, it moves like thunder.

One hundred Black Capricorn knights clamped the horse's belly at the same time, and the war horse raised its hooves and ran wildly. The iron hoofs crushed the thick snow, making a loud roar.

The sound of horse hooves gathered in one place, getting closer and closer, the ground shook slightly, and the black cavalry rushed straight towards the front wall of Blackstone Castle like a sharp arrow.

On horseback, Jie Bing leaned down and lowered his center of gravity, controlling the horse with one hand and holding the scimitar tightly with the other. His eyes were fierce and bloodthirsty, and he was ready to climb the wall and kill him during the charge.

On top of the wall, everyone tensed up and their palms were covered in cold sweat.

"Form up! Guard the front!" Su Jin shouted in a deep voice.

Chen Shitou led several soldiers and placed all the collected gravel and broken spears next to the wall stacks. They formed groups of two and clung to the wall, holding their breath and staring at the charging cavalry.
